shots.line: In 2021, a TikTok user named Jason Klein
shots.scene: room night: Jason at desk, laptop glow, slow push
insert: globe, pulsing dot over the desert, zoom in

shots.line: and he found something in the Nevada desert that he could not explain.
shots.scene: bigFace Jason: neutral to shocked, screen glow left

shots.line: He zoomed in on a ghost town called Rhyolite.
shots.scene: satellite map zooms to the desert, crosshair, RHYOLITE label pops

shots.line: It was an old gold rush town, and almost nobody lived there anymore.
shots.scene: ghost town wide at dusk, ruins, one lamp, tumbleweed, slow push

shots.line: But in the middle of the desert, he saw about a dozen figures,
shots.scene: desert wide: twelve white cloaks in a line on the horizon, slow push
desert medium: the line of cloaks closer, robes swaying almost imperceptibly

shots.line: They were standing still, in a line, in the empty sand.
shots.scene: FREEZE: the line of cloaks, hanging dust, cool tint, slow rotation, STILL badge

shots.line: One of them was holding a bicycle.
shots.scene: insert: one cloak figure with a bicycle, wheel glint, slow push

shots.line: Jason posted the video on TikTok.
shots.scene: insert: phone in Jason's hand, desert thumbnail, POST tap

shots.line: It was watched more than 17 million times
shots.scene: data card: VIEWS counter ticks up to 17,000,000 in gold
end wide: the line of cloaks at dusk, 17 MILLION VIEWS, slow pull-out
